iterations.publicRationale: No evidence has been collected yet. The SG-only regional signal and limited available tooling motivate three competing explanations: an app/config regression specific to SG, an SG regional infrastructure/dependency outage, or a telemetry undercount artifact.

This is the first evidence-gathering step. User feedback in the incident window can discriminate H1 (SG app/config regression) from H2 (SG infrastructure impairment) and H3 (telemetry artifact): reports pointing to a new app/version/feature failure would SUPPORT H1; network/payment/gateway/carrier-style reports would SUPPORT H2; absence of real delivery complaints while the metric drops would support H3. SUCCESS action: classify feedback wording and update the corresponding hypotheses. EMPTY action: no feedback matches, so proceed to search_similar_incidents and a region segment_metric comparison to see whether SG is isolated, rather than repeating feedback calls. Query value is DISCRIMINATING because it separates the app-regression hypothesis from the infrastructure hypothesis and the measurement-artifact hypothesis.
